Tying Trevenant (Japanese: オーロット、しばる , Bind) is the 574th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 26th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Celosia begins the operation to move Xerneas.
Celosia's presents Celosia a piece of Y's hair that it chopped off earlier.
When notices the hair, she briefly regains slight control of herself and tries to take the hair only to be knocked to the ground.
When Y sees this, she immediately attacks Celosia, only to fall due to her damaged Sky Suit.
X leaps in to help Y, but his attempts to simultaneously Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga and fail and he is captured by Essentia's .
Essentia captures everyone with her Trevenant's vines.
Celosia attempts to finish X off, but a stops her from killing him.
Korrina, Diantha, and Gurkinn arrive to save X and his friends.
